title: Not glass like, its plastic. Says lid is BPA free, but is the container also?
text:
Not glass like, its plastic. Says lid is BPA free, but is the container also?. I recieved one good size plastic container, with lid, and pump.

The pump seems to take the air out of the container, and your food, and left overs will last you longer.
This can go in the freezer.
I would put a small strip of masking tape on the top and write the date, and what is in this when I put this in the freezer.

I thought the container was to be glass, but its Not, it is hard plastic. It say glass like!
Says vacuumed sealed airtight Lid is BPA free, does that mean The container is Not? If Not, I won’t be using this!
I would Not put this in the micro, or dishwasher, as I think it is too porous , and might not be BPA free, but it’s easy to wash.

It took me awhile to finally get the air out of this!, but then when I push my finger down in the little hole to release the air as it says to do, It did not take the air out, and I tried a few times, I could not get this to open for a while!
Since its new that could be the reason, I hope.

product_metadata.title: SNUGTOPIA Food Storage Container with Vacuum Sealed Airtight Lid BPA Free, 1 Glass-like Tritan Container with Manual Pump, Microwave, Freezer, Dishwasher Safe, Stain Proof, 47.34 oz
